adaptations: Independent strict D implementation, not imported specialized benchmark function. Phobos Region!Mallocator standard-library memory pool replaces default GC. Every node calls pool.allocate(Node.sizeof), leaf/interior same size16 bytes. Capacity formula reserves storage; never substitutes for node construction/traversal. deallocateAll resets only after complete tree check. Seven TaskPool workers plus caller at most8. No custom allocator code; all traversal/allocation calls in D source.
